messages:
Maya: Heads up — we saw three nodes in eu-west-1 (rack-g4-*) surface intermittent Xid 13s during long KV-cache workloads. Suspect a flaky card but repro is inconsistent when network traffic is noisy. Can we coordinate a soak run that also replays network microbursts and NVMe noise?
Sam: Yikes. Which nodes exactly?
Maya: g4-rack-12-slot2 / g4-rack-14-slot1 / g4-rack-14-slot3. Logs attached in the incident thread but summary: Xid 13 + ECC corrections spike when sequence length > 2048 and prefix caching hits ~70%.
Oliver: Would like to add PCIe reset injection and ambient temp variance to the soak. Last time the card recovered after a timed PCI reset.
Jing: Agreed. Also saw correlated NVMe read errors on the host that preceded the first Xid on two of the nodes — could be power/PMIC related. Worth injecting NVMe IO noise.
Ben: I'm happy to own the run. Proposal: fork soak-harness to a new profile that replays telemetry, injects NIC egress shaping, and toggles PCIe power at configurable intervals.
Maya: That sounds right. Please include deterministic seeds so runs are reproducible. We should also avoid impacting production racks. Use the quarantine lab or dedicated maintenance pool.
Ben: Plan draft in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-soak/pull/412 (quicklink). Key snippet:

```
soak-run --profile=gpu-flake-repro \\n  --cycles=1200 \\n  --kv-pressure=75 \\n  --seq-len=2048,4096 \\n  --repro-seed=4621 \\n  --nvme-noise=randio:0.6 \\n  --pci-reset-interval=300s \\n  --net-egress-burst=2MB:10ms
```

Ben: That creates controlled microbursts on egress and periodic PCIe resets. Telemetry replay will feed historic host metrics to the harness so the card sees the same load profile.
Sam: Nice. Two asks: 1) Add an option to run without PCIe reset so we can see pure workload-triggered failures, 2) Export a minimal repro artifact (trace + minimal input) when an Xid occurs.
Ben: Both doable. I'll add `--no-pci-reset` and `--dump-repro-on-fail=/tmp/repro` flags.
infra-bot: deploy-check: starting soak profile gpu-flake-repro in maintenance-pool-2. ETA 7m.
Maya: Also we should capture power telemetry — attach PMIC logs and wall-socket current when available. The NVMe errors make me worried about local power source oscillation.
Jing: We'll coordinate with facilities to enable inline power metering for those racks. If facilities can't, add AC toggles in harness to emulate voltage droops.
Oliver: For network shaping: don't just throttle sustained bandwidth — the failure seems to prefer high short bursts. Use 5-15ms bursts with short idle gaps.
Ben: I'll tune the net-egress-burst param to `--net-egress-burst=3MB:12ms,0.5MB:6ms` to create a bimodal distribution.
Maya: Good. Also add a small kernel oops monitor — when Xid occurs capture dmesg + nvidia-smi -q and persist to artifact store.
Ben: Will push. Also adding gating so we don't auto-return nodes to service unless the run completes 2 full cycles with zero Xid/ECC > 0.1% errors.
Sam: Can we add a health-check that simulates latency-sensitive tenants (low batch, low KV hit) in parallel? I want to know if the soak profile causes tail-latency regression for small RT workloads.
Ben: Yes — `--parallel-tenant=latency-sensitive:ratio=0.2` will hammer small requests while soak does the heavy long sequence runs.
Maya: Ops oncall, we may need an expedited drain + replacement if the soak reproduces persistent flake. Thoughts on spare pool?
Ops oncall: We have two cold spares in eu-west-1 and capacity in us-west-2 if cross-region move needed. Prefer to replace in-rack if warranty allows; otherwise swap to spare and quarantine.
Jing: One more note — correlate ECC counters with NVLink counters; last incident had NVLink CRC errors ~20s before Xid on one node. Add NVLink sampling.
Ben: Adding NVLink sampling to telemetry-replay. Also will include a `--replay-since` option so we can replay the exact pre-failure window for each node.
Maya: Timeline: Ben to push PR and run first sweep in maintenance-pool-2 today. Capture artifacts and report back with a 1-pager on findings & recommended replacement threshold.
Ben: On it. I'll post run summary + artifact links here when complete. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: soak-run gpu-flake-repro started on maintenance-pool-2 at 2087654372. Job id: soak-2026-03-18-09-12.
Sam: :eyes: thanks everyone.
Maya: If we do reproduce, let's schedule a short cross-team postmortem so HW, infra, and facilities can decide replacement vs firmware/NVDATA update.
Ben: Agreed. I'll also include the deterministic repro artifacts so FW team can try targeted microcode tests.
Ops oncall: I'll prep spare allocation just in case.
Maya: Great — locking this thread for updates only.
Ben: First sweep done, uploading artifacts (will post link shortly).
